Morning – Hope your well, thank you for the request.


 


I'm just reviewing the information.


 


Regarding the Fall, in PIR the only one we could use is 1.30 Board which is (30-60mm) – Only a 30mm Step,



 


You require a 150mm Step across 1200mm,  


 


Only other Option we could do is go hybrid, PIR Overlay and EPS customise the Fall e.g. 35mm -150mm?


 


Once confirmed well be happy to put together a provisional scheme for you


 


 


Kind Regards,
